changes.description: Now unblocking native notice review and automating proposal PRs.
Faster canvas compositing for opacity, clipping, adjustments and custom blends.
Improved startup time.
Reduced editor rebuilds and redundant rendering.
Removed menu action delays and redundant thumbnail captures.
Implemented native brush composition and extended color processing.
Now preserving exact document colors across editing, pickers and PSD.
Now showing the release notes corresponding to the difference between the current version and the latest version.
Adjustments, Camera Raw, Apply Image and exports keep HDR and wide-gamut colors.
Copies, cuts and background renders keep high-depth precision.
Distinguish file access failures from image format errors
Fixed "File > Save" and/or CTRL+S opening a save dialog for 1-layer PNG files.
Hide external support links in Mac App Store builds.
Now reporting file access failures with actionable recovery.
Preserved precision across native editing and interchange.
Removed the 16 px space between dialogs border and vertical scrollbar.
Added a `CompositePlan` to compute the structural paint decisions of a document once before painting.
Updated DBUS slot name.
Updated the design of tool parameters (better coherence and harmony).
Various simplifications and bugs fixes in the app codebase.
Now using `pickpick` to pick on-screen colors.
Replaced kernel templates with analyzable Dart sources.
Share duplicated editing, shader, RAW and blur code.
Unified high-precision compositing across canvas, merges, and exports.
Fixed a compilation problem.
Improved build scripts.
Fixed a gradient rendering problem.
Fixed a bug with asynchronous loading of translations.
Fixed various bugs with the Eraser tool.
Added `snap` as a distribution target.
Improved the new document dialog UI.
Various QoL improvements.
Improved the Fill tool performances.
Fixed a bug with text alignments.
Added more keyboard shortcuts when editing a text.
Localized the app in more languages (es, pt, de, it).
Added a startup splash screen displaying initialization progress.
Added merge actions to the layer context menu.
Now stacking dithered gradient layers.
Fixed a blink bug that was occurring when zooming / moving the canvas.
Fixed gradient banding on the home screen.
Built-in brushes are now saved as `fbrush` presets.
Built-in coutours, swatches, gradients, curves and styles are now saved as `fcontour`, `fswatch`, `fgradient`, `fcurve` and `fstyle` presets.
Built-in patterns are now saved as `fpattern` presets.
Built-in shapes are now saved as `fshape` presets.
Improved the home screen UI.
Now preventing the update dialog from closing while working.
Updated the hero background.
Updated the website branding.
Various UI improvements.
Updated Sentry license notices and reviewed dependency metadata.
Improved license reviewing by adding a Github workflow dedicated to it.
Added Photoshop contours support.
Added exact layer-effect contours, Porter-Duff blending, and native adjustment presets.
Added portable presets and improved Photoshop style fidelity.
Added support for more Photoshop formats.
Added an auto-update dialog.
Now concurrently decoding and prefetching project raster tiles.
Updated the database directory in release mode.
Updated release pipeline.
Fixed a permission error on Linux.
Moved the build script to `get-focale`.
Fixed various compilation errors.
Initial release.
